title: Polite Irony, Conversational Warmth, and Essayistic Distance

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Antal Szerb mastered the art of wearing monumental erudition (*erudíció*) with effortless lightness (*könnyedség*). His prose employs delicate conversational understatement, gentle self-irony (*önirónia*), and witty parentheticals, for example in the manner of *ahogy a kedves olvasó bizonyára sejti* (an example of the style, not a quotation).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: You know softening from B2 Unit 29 (*célszerű lenne*, *indokolt volna*). Szerb's essays soften assertions in the same spirit: a phrase such as *aligha tévedünk, ha úgy véljük* ('we are hardly wrong if we think') invites the reader into a collegial conspiracy of cultivated minds.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A tudós erudíció és a szellemes könnyedség ötvözete...
The synthesis of scholarly erudition and witty lightness...
Aligha tévedünk, ha úgy véljük, hogy...
We are hardly wrong to think that...
He observes the world with subtle self-irony...
